material_findings.title: Microsoft Inside the Game: Premier League Developer Hackathon — new AI/multi-agent build lead
material_findings.source_name: Microsoft official rules and Microsoft Reactor
material_findings.observed: microsoft premier league inside the game official rules checked 2026-10-08 | registration Sep 29 2026 09:00 PT to Oct 20 2026 12:00 PT | submissions Oct 6 2026 09:00 PT to Oct 27 2026 23:59 PT | no purchase/payment necessary | age-of-majority individuals and teams up to four subject to geographic and conflict exclusions | newly created project using synthetic football event data and Microsoft AI platform | public GitHub repository, under-two-minute public demo, pitch, rights to all data | Best Multi-Agent System category | first prize 4000 USD e-gift-card per individual team member plus ticket and store voucher, second 2500 per member, category awards 1500 per member; total prize-pool ARV 14800-59200 depending team sizes | entrant registration and cloud cost unconfirmed | listing does not authorize testing.
material_findings.entry_cost: Official rules state no purchase/payment necessary to enter or win. Azure/cloud usage costs and any credits were not independently established.
material_findings.eligibility: Age-of-majority individuals, teams up to four, and organizations, subject to geographic/legal and organizer-conflict exclusions; participant-specific eligibility/registration not established.
material_findings.prize_evidence: Official rules Section 8: first grand prize includes USD 4,000 per team member as an e-gift-card plus Premier League ticket/store voucher; second includes USD 2,500 per member plus ticket/voucher; four category prizes include USD 1,500 e-gift-card per member. Total ARV USD 14,800–59,200 depends on winning team sizes and includes non-cash components. A project may win one grand and one category prize. E-gift-cards are not equivalent to a guaranteed bank cash payout; identity/forms/taxes and redemption terms apply.
material_findings.requirements: New project after Sep 29 registration begins; synthetic football-realistic event data, Microsoft AI platform integration, meaningful football analytics/narratives; public GitHub repository, functional project and public demo video shorter than two minutes, plus pitch. Best Multi-Agent System prize is relevant to the suite's agent orchestration lane. Existing suite cannot be submitted unchanged.
material_findings.authorization_scope: This is a build competition, not permission to test Microsoft, Premier League, Azure, GitHub, public infrastructure, third-party services, or copyrighted football footage. Use synthetic or properly licensed data and comply with all SDK/API/cloud terms.
material_findings.deduplication: No matching Microsoft Premier League / insidethegamehackathon finding in current-main canonical intelligence/opportunities, repository code search, or open PR titles. The Sep 30 Build With AI Basics finding is a different Devpost competition and was not duplicated.
missing_verification: Live registration portal redirected to Microsoft Innovation Studio but was not accessible in this read-only research runtime; confirm it accepts registration and that the entrant is registered before active case creation.
Verify entrant-specific jurisdiction and conflict exclusions, actual Azure service costs/available credits, and access to the Microsoft AI platform features needed for a feasible prototype.
Recheck official rules for amendments, confirm synthetic football data provenance and licenses, and preserve proof of new post-Sep-29 development.
Check the discrepancy between category label 'Best Multi-Agent System' in Section 4.2 and 'Best Multi-Agent Orchestration' in the prize table; treat as one category only after organizer confirmation.
material_findings.next_action: After Aug 30 morning canonical replay and chronological integration, re-open official Microsoft rules and registration. If participant registration/eligibility and platform costs pass, create one structured build case for a genuinely new synthetic-football multi-agent project; document provenance and integrate through canonical intelligence/opportunities/cases and site-data builder. Do not add Microsoft as a recurring source solely for this one-off event.

material_findings.title: GaianSpace CTF 2026: registration already closed despite upcoming-event listing

material_findings.deduplication: No matching GaianSpace canonical intelligence/opportunity record or open research PR found. Keep as source-health warning, not a new active opportunity.
material_findings.next_action: Do not create an active new-entry case. If an existing registered team is later established, recheck the official rules and scope before any competition activity; otherwise retain as historical source-health context.
